question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To play with fire
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e. **'To take foolish risk'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom** "to play with fire" **means to do something dangerous or risky, or to involve oneself in a situation that could lead to harm or disaster.(मूर्खतापूर्ण जोखिम लेना)
